review_description: I paid more because I was sold perfection supposedly not offered by other installers.They cancelled their original installation late on the due day and rebooked.When they eventually arrived, their installers didn't care how many roof tiles they broke, how badly they damaged my gutters by not using a gutter guard and how much mess they left behind removing my old system.They damaged a solar panel, wired the system incorrectly and then threatened to switch off my solar system if I didn't finalise my rebate within 24 hours.It's been one month since they installed the system and still haven't fixed the damage. This is even after writing directly to their General Manager, [Name Removed].They've been around for a long time and won awards in the past, so things must have changed dramatically for the worse.

I lodged a claim for the JFY inverter and was advised it would take a least 4 weeks for a replacement to arrive from China. JFY would send it directly to my address and I would have to arrange a electrician to remove and install the new JFY inverter. I was not happy with this as I had already missed out on the savings from using the solar panels on previous electric bill and now have to wait another period of no savings on the next bill. I contacted Solar Naturally Sales and spoke to the sales manager (Marselo) and explained my situation to him, Marcelo was very sympathetic towards my issue and said he could rectify my issue within 14 days. I said I would believe it when I see it thinking, yeah! he told me what I wanted to hear and I would still have to wait. Well! how wrong was I. I was told this on Monday morning, I received a call from sales, (Jacinta) Monday afternoon to say they were looking into my issue.
